source: SQuAD v1.1 train+dev; paragraphs with exactly one question (327). Excluded: 1 overlapping the public QA 1000 set (paragraph context/item id match), then filters used in e57_public_qa_build_squad (answer 2-chars..6 words and present in context, question-paragraph common run<=3) plus paragraph length 40-160 words -> 137 eligible; 128 chosen round-robin over titles by md5 hash (seed e57-qa128-v1). Titles Super_Bowl_50 and Warsaw absent. Only the first listed answer is the gold.
check: check128.py: gold verbatim in every rewrite; length 0.6-1.5x original; longest common run of non-entity words <=5 between any two of original+16 rewrites (same rule as check16/check64). Final: 128/128 paragraphs pass, run max 5 median 3, 0 duplicates.
first_try_paragraph_failure_rate: round A ~77% (92/120 paragraphs, 15 of 16 agents tracked), round B ~89% (107/120); all fixed by rewriting failing items until pass
generation_disclosure: These 2048 rewrites were written by Claude (Sonnet 5.5) through 16 parallel Claude subagents in a Claude Code session on 2026-11-15/16, each writing 8 paragraphs x 16 versions in two rounds of 8 with the checker in the loop. This differs in generator and procedure from the earlier 50-paragraph rewrite sets (rewrite16/rewrite64 under data/public-qa); do not pool across them without tagging the source.
format: rewrites_16_qa128.json = {pid: [16 strings]}; paragraphs128.json = list of {pid,title,context,golds,qs,item_ids,n_main,split}, same keys as rewrite/paragraphs.json
